name: code_interpreter
description: Run Python in an OpenAI-managed sandbox via the provider's built-in code_interpreter tool. Provider-native — executed server-side by the Responses API (Codex OAuth / OpenAI Responses). Enable by listing `code_interpreter` in your agent's tools.md. Streams `code_interpreter_call.code.delta` events that the UI can render as the sandbox executes. For local-machine Python execution use `bash` with a python invocation instead.

container.description: Optional sandbox container configuration. Passed through to the provider verbatim.
